name: EchoBraid
purpose: A neurodivergent-affirming learning companion that keeps your pace. A soft writing loop, guided breathing, a memory game, prime-numbered reflection prompts and a formal-logic workbench, where every decision is made by a guest whose rules are proved in Lean.
tagline: Your pace is law here. Every rule is proved.
hint: Write, breathe or play. Nothing turns on without your choice.

promise.headline: It never pushes, never turns a sensor on by itself, and offers a pause before anything else when things run high.
promise.detail: Drift stays between 0 and 100, a pause is offered only when it is divergent, every breath countdown stays in its phase, no consent turns on without its own grant, and every rhythm the engine adds is proved safe first.

claim: EB-01 to EB-13: drift is bounded, a pause comes first when drift is divergent, every breath countdown is in range, no consent turns on silently, the memory game is fair, quorums intersect, retention is honoured, and every engine-discovered rhythm is proved safe.

proposition.name: pauseComesFirst
proposition.text:
offersPause drift = true -> guideIndex drift variant = 0

offersPause drift := 80 < drift
guideIndex drift variant :=
  if offersPause drift then 0
  else 1 + coherenceRank drift * 3 + variant % 3
proposition.plain: Whenever drift runs past 80, the guide's only answer is the offer of a pause.
